SELECT column_name
FROM TAP_SCHEMA.columns
WHERE table_name = 'ivoa.obscore'
    AND column_name IN ('s_resolution', 's_fov', 't_min', 't_max', 'band_list', 'pol_states')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matches
FROM ivoa.obscore
WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', s_ra, s_dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 253.245253999941, 2.40098600000265, 1e-06))
    AND science_observation = 'T'

SELECT
    proposal_id,
    obs_publisher_did,
    group_ous_uid,
    member_ous_uid,
    asdm_uid,
    obs_id,
    target_name,
    s_ra,
    s_dec,
    s_region,
    frequency,
    bandwidth,
    em_xel,
    frequency_support,
    spectral_resolution,
    spatial_resolution,
    sensitivity_10kms,
    cont_sensitivity_bandwidth,
    antenna_arrays,
    is_mosaic,
    science_observation,
    qa2_passed,
    obs_release_date,
    lastModified,
    s_resolution,
    s_fov,
    t_min,
    t_max,
    band_list,
    pol_states
FROM ivoa.obscore
WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', s_ra, s_dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 253.245253999941, 2.40098600000265, 1e-06))
    AND science_observation = 'T'
